def Perennial.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.isInitialized : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ errStopped errCompacted errUnavailable errSnapUnavail errPropDropped globalRand' localMsgs responseMsgs
      errStepLocal errStepPeer,
      "ErrStopped" ∷ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrStopped) errStopped DFrac.discard ∗
        "%HErrStopped" ∷ ⌜errStopped ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
          "ErrSnapUnavail" ∷ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrSnapshotTemporarilyUnavailable) errSnapUnavail DFrac.discard ∗
            "%HErrSnapUnavail" ∷ ⌜errSnapUnavail ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
              "%HErrSnapUnavail_new" ∷ ⌜IsNewError errSnapUnavail⌝ ∗
                "ErrCompacted" ∷ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrCompacted) errCompacted DFrac.discard ∗
                  "%HErrCompacted" ∷ ⌜errCompacted ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                    "ErrUnavailable" ∷ typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrUnavailable) errUnavailable DFrac.discard ∗
                      "%HErrUnavailable" ∷ ⌜errUnavailable ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                        "%HErrCompacted_new" ∷ ⌜IsNewError errCompacted⌝ ∗
                          "%HErrUnavailable_new" ∷ ⌜IsNewError errUnavailable⌝ ∗
                            "ErrPropDropped" ∷
                                typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrProposalDropped) errPropDropped DFrac.discard ∗
                              "%HErrPropDropped" ∷ ⌜errPropDropped ≠ GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                "#globalRand" ∷ typedPointsto (globalAddr globalRand) globalRand' DFrac.discard ∗
                                  "#HglobalRand" ∷ isLockedRand globalRand' ∗
                                    ("#emptyState" ∷
                                        ∃ es,
                                          typedPointsto (globalAddr emptyState) es DFrac.discard ∗
                                            ⌜es ≠ null⌝ ∗
                                              typedPointsto
                                                  (structFieldRef raftpb.HardState go!"Term" es) null
                                                  DFrac.discard ∗
                                                typedPointsto
                                                    (structFieldRef raftpb.HardState go!"Vote" es) null
                                                    DFrac.discard ∗
                                                  typedPointsto
                                                      (structFieldRef raftpb.HardState
                                                        go!"Commit" es)
                                                      null DFrac.discard ∗
                                                    inv (nroot.@"protobuf")
                                                      iprop(∃ st sc us,
                                                          typedPointsto
                                                              (structFieldRef raftpb.HardState
                                                                go!"state" es)
                                                              st (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                            typedPointsto
                                                                (structFieldRef raftpb.HardState
                                                                  go!"sizeCache"
                                                                  es)
                                                                sc (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                              typedPointsto
                                                                  (structFieldRef raftpb.HardState
                                                                    go!"unknownFields"
                                                                    es)
                                                                  us (DFrac.own 1) ∗
                                                                ownSlice us [] (DFrac.own 1))) ∗
                                      "#isLocalMsg" ∷ typedPointsto (globalAddr isLocalMsg) localMsgs DFrac.discard ∗
                                        "#isResponseMsg" ∷
                                            typedPointsto (globalAddr isResponseMsg) responseMsgs DFrac.discard ∗
                                          "#ErrStepLocalMsg" ∷
                                              typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrStepLocalMsg) errStepLocal DFrac.discard ∗
                                            "#ErrStepPeerNotFound" ∷
                                                typedPointsto (globalAddr ErrStepPeerNotFound) errStepPeer DFrac.discard ∗
                                              ("#ErrBreak" ∷
                                                  ∃ eb,
                                                    typedPointsto (globalAddr errBreak) eb DFrac.discard ∗
